summary: Full backend + frontend test of Sur Detective. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass (puzzle/today shape, stability, archive, past/future case, guess correct+wrong, reveal, admin CRUD, CSV import). Frontend flow verified end-to-end on the daily case: waveform, play, 6 mcq options, wrong-guess grows clip 0:01→0:02, skip counts as attempt and grows clip 0:02→0:04, correct guess opens verdict screen with share grid & share button. Verdict persists after reload (localStorage). Archive tab lists 61 cases with 'archive-case' testids. Stats tab renders. Admin (/admin) lists songs, add-song and delete work. Fixed one backend bug affecting admin frontend integration: Song response returned '_id' instead of 'id'; refactored BaseDocument to expose 'id' and strip Mongo _id from all admin song responses.

minor.issue: Was returning raw Mongo '_id' instead of 'id' due to Pydantic alias config. Fixed in server.py BaseDocument (from_mongo/to_mongo).

action_items: None blocking. Optional: seeded CSV contains a non-Bollywood entry ('Smells Like Teen Spirit') which happens to be today's Case #219 answer — verify this is intentional for the noir Bollywood theme.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: get_or_create_puzzle does N+1 async Mongo fetches to score distractors (one find_one per candidate). Acceptable for 26 songs, but should batch with $in or $sample as catalog grows.
Admin routes are open (no auth) — flagged as intentional per spec ('academic prototype') but should be gated before real deploy.
CSV import upsert key is (title, artist); duplicates with slight punctuation differences would create dupes.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_ prefixed rows created during tests were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Case #219 (today, IST) = 'Smells Like Teen Spirit' per current seed order. Reveal endpoint can be used to drive UI tests. Admin list now returns 'id' field — do not revert BaseDocument.
